comment: Every connection the browser makes on its own. The Protection page, net_audit.py and tools/check_connections.py all read this file. After editing it run: python boring-core/tools/check_connections.py --write

connections.label: Secure DNS
connections.why: Looks up site addresses privately. Also blocks known scam sites.
connections.off_note: With this off, scam blocking gets weaker.

connections.label: Blocking and scam lists
connections.why: Checks for newer lists about once a week. No account, no cookie.

connections.label: Browser updates
connections.why: Asks once a day whether a newer version exists.

connections.label: Chrome Web Store
connections.why: Only while you have store add-ons. Checks for their updates.
